task.evidence: 10 May – Counter Terrorism Policing arrest a man and a woman on suspicion of conspiracy to commit arson following an attack at the former East London Central Synagogue in Whitechapel. Police say the incident is being investigated alongside several apparent attacks on Jewish sites in London since late March.

answer:
In May 2026, Counter Terrorism Policing investigated a wave of antisemitic attacks targeting the Jewish community in London, which included incidents like arson of synagogues and stabbings. These attacks were linked to groups associated with Iran. 

FINAL: Antisemitic attacks against the Jewish community.
